rationale: The long thesis has weakened: price at $69.28 has slipped below the 5m 9-EMA ($69.44) and given back most of its 1.27% favorable excursion, with the last 1m candle closing at its low on the highest volume of the recent sequence. While RKLB remains above VWAP ($68.93) in a risk-on tape, the stalled momentum right at the short-term EMA makes locking in the modest gain preferable to risking a slide back toward the $68.60 invalidation; the case for a short flip is not supported by the bullish regime.
